d: We are looking for a General Accountant to join our Finance team in Riyadh. The role is responsible for maintaining accurate accounting records, supporting the month-end close, and preparing VAT returns and supporting documentation for zakat filings.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or a related field.
2 to 3 years of hands-on tax experience including preparing VAT returns and supporting zakat filings.
Professional certification in zakat and tax.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and practical experience with ERP systems.
r: Prepare and post journal entries, reconcile general ledger accounts, and investigate discrepancies as part of the month-end close.
Review project progress billings, subcontractor invoices, and advance payments to verify the correct VAT treatment.
Prepare VAT returns and reconcile VAT balances against the general ledger before submission.
Prepare zakat schedules, maintain supporting records, and assist with inquiries and audits from the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA).
